records.context: The Hybrid gene profile and its guide rows in one fitted gene-level space.
records.label: spacr.ops_reference.hybrid_profile_rows#0
records.source: The Hybrid gene profile and its guide rows in one fitted gene-level space.
records.translation: Hybrid-genprofilen och dess guiderader i ett och samma anpassade rum på gennivå.

records.context: The Hybrid profile of the OPS profile path is the Brieflow cell recipe's gene table (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.profile_cell_tables` with the ``brieflow`` recipe) embedded at the gene level: columns with 5 % or more missing values are dropped, other gaps take the column median, constant columns are dropped, the rest are standardised and a PCA keeping ``variance`` of the variance is fitted on the gene rows (:func:`embed_gene_profiles`). The guide rows go through that same fitted transform, so a guide bootstrap (:func:`spacr.ops_clusters.guide_bootstrap_profiles`) moves a gene within the space it is clustered in, without refitting the embedding per draw.
records.label: spacr.ops_reference.hybrid_profile_rows#1
records.source: The Hybrid profile of the OPS profile path is the Brieflow cell recipe's gene table (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.profile_cell_tables` with the ``brieflow`` recipe) embedded at the gene level: columns with 5 % or more missing values are dropped, other gaps take the column median, constant columns are dropped, the rest are standardised and a PCA keeping ``variance`` of the variance is fitted on the gene rows (:func:`embed_gene_profiles`). The guide rows go through that same fitted transform, so a guide bootstrap (:func:`spacr.ops_clusters.guide_bootstrap_profiles`) moves a gene within the space it is clustered in, without refitting the embedding per draw.
records.translation: Hybrid-profilen i OPS-profilvägen är genetabellen från Brieflows cellrecept (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.profile_cell_tables` med receptet ``brieflow``) inbäddad på gennivå: kolumner med 5 % eller fler saknade värden tas bort, övriga luckor får kolumnens median, konstanta kolumner tas bort, resten standardiseras och en PCA som behåller ``variance`` av variansen anpassas på genraderna (:func:`embed_gene_profiles`). Guideraderna går genom samma anpassade transform, så att en guide-bootstrap (:func:`spacr.ops_clusters.guide_bootstrap_profiles`) flyttar en gen inom det rum där den klustras, utan att inbäddningen anpassas om för varje dragning.

records.context: The cells of every microplate sample position are filtered and imputed (:func:`_profile_well`), embedded by a PCA keeping 99 % of the variance (:func:`_profile_embedding`), normalised by TVN on the control cells with the microplate sample position as batch (:func:`tvn_on_controls`, whitening epsilon ``ops_tvn_whiten_epsilon``; 0 is Brieflow's TVN and is computed at single precision as Brieflow does, a positive value at double), and reduced to guides (median of cells) and genes (median of guides, or of cells; with the ``gene_trim`` recipe both take the 10 % trimmed mean of their cells), keeping rows with more than ``ops_profile_min_cells`` cells (:func:`cells_to_profiles`). A hits table can then keep only active genes and the control rows.
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn.profile_cell_tables#1
records.source: The cells of every well are filtered and imputed (:func:`_profile_well`), embedded by a PCA keeping 99 % of the variance (:func:`_profile_embedding`), normalised by TVN on the control cells with the well as batch (:func:`tvn_on_controls`, whitening epsilon ``ops_tvn_whiten_epsilon``; 0 is Brieflow's TVN and is computed at single precision as Brieflow does, a positive value at double), and reduced to guides (median of cells) and genes (median of guides, or of cells; with the ``gene_trim`` recipe both take the 10 % trimmed mean of their cells), keeping rows with more than ``ops_profile_min_cells`` cells (:func:`cells_to_profiles`). A hits table can then keep only active genes and the control rows.
records.translation: Cellerna i varje brunn filtreras och imputeras (:func:`_profile_well`), bäddas in med en PCA som behåller 99 % av variansen (:func:`_profile_embedding`), normaliseras med TVN på kontrollcellerna med brunnen som batch (:func:`tvn_on_controls`, vitningsepsilon ``ops_tvn_whiten_epsilon``; 0 är Brieflows TVN och beräknas i enkel precision så som Brieflow gör, ett positivt värde i dubbel) och reduceras till guider (median av celler) och gener (median av guider, eller av celler; med receptet ``gene_trim`` tar båda det 10 % trimmade medelvärdet av sina celler), varvid rader med fler än ``ops_profile_min_cells`` celler behålls (:func:`cells_to_profiles`). En träfftabell kan sedan behålla bara aktiva gener och kontrollraderna.

records.context: any of the :data:`PROFILE_RECIPE` structured-data names. ``lof`` 1 drops the 1 % of cells a local outlier factor finds on the mean intensities; ``impute`` ``'knn'`` fills gaps by five nearest neighbours, as Brieflow does; ``pca`` ``'brieflow'`` fits the PCA on 100,000 cells standardised by well with Brieflow's sampling; ``agg`` ``'gene'`` takes the median of all of a gene's cells, and ``'gene_trim'`` their 10 % trimmed mean (:data:`PROFILE_TRIM_FRACTION` cut from each end, ``scipy.stats.trim_mean``; guide rows then take the same trimmed mean of their cells); ``nt`` ``'barcode'`` keeps each non-targeting guide as its own row; ``tvn`` ``'brieflow'`` finds the TVN control axes as Brieflow does (:func:`tvn_on_controls` ``rotation`` ``'brieflow'``), which the Hybrid profile needs to match Brieflow's recipe value for value.
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn.profile_recipe#1
records.source: any of the :data:`PROFILE_RECIPE` keys. ``lof`` 1 drops the 1 % of cells a local outlier factor finds on the mean intensities; ``impute`` ``'knn'`` fills gaps by five nearest neighbours, as Brieflow does; ``pca`` ``'brieflow'`` fits the PCA on 100,000 cells standardised by well with Brieflow's sampling; ``agg`` ``'gene'`` takes the median of all of a gene's cells, and ``'gene_trim'`` their 10 % trimmed mean (:data:`PROFILE_TRIM_FRACTION` cut from each end, ``scipy.stats.trim_mean``; guide rows then take the same trimmed mean of their cells); ``nt`` ``'barcode'`` keeps each non-targeting guide as its own row; ``tvn`` ``'brieflow'`` finds the TVN control axes as Brieflow does (:func:`tvn_on_controls` ``rotation`` ``'brieflow'``), which the Hybrid profile needs to match Brieflow's recipe value for value.
records.translation: vilken som helst av nycklarna i :data:`PROFILE_RECIPE`. ``lof`` 1 tar bort den 1 % av cellerna som en lokal avvikelsefaktor (local outlier factor) hittar på medelintensiteterna; ``impute`` ``'knn'`` fyller luckor med fem närmaste grannar, så som Brieflow gör; ``pca`` ``'brieflow'`` anpassar PCA:n på 100,000 celler standardiserade per brunn med Brieflows urval; ``agg`` ``'gene'`` tar medianen av alla en gens celler, och ``'gene_trim'`` deras 10 % trimmade medelvärde (:data:`PROFILE_TRIM_FRACTION` skuret från varje ände, ``scipy.stats.trim_mean``; guiderader tar då samma trimmade medelvärde av sina celler); ``nt`` ``'barcode'`` behåller varje icke-riktad guide som en egen rad; ``tvn`` ``'brieflow'`` hittar TVN-kontrollaxlarna så som Brieflow gör (:func:`tvn_on_controls` ``rotation`` ``'brieflow'``), vilket Hybrid-profilen behöver för att återge Brieflows recept värde för värde.

records.context: The steps follow Brieflow's ``tvn_on_controls``: centre and scale on all control cells, rotate onto the principal axes of the control cells, centre and scale every axis on each batch's control cells, then CORAL.
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn.tvn_on_controls#10
records.source: The steps follow Brieflow's ``tvn_on_controls``: centre and scale on all control cells, rotate onto the principal axes of the control cells, centre and scale every axis on each batch's control cells, then CORAL.
records.translation: Stegen följer Brieflows ``tvn_on_controls``: centrera och skala på alla kontrollceller, rotera till kontrollcellernas huvudaxlar, centrera och skala varje axel på varje batchs kontrollceller, sedan CORAL.

records.context: how the control axes are found. ``'eigh'``, the default, takes them from a double-precision eigendecomposition of the control covariance (:func:`_control_basis`); ``'brieflow'`` fits scikit-learn's ``PCA`` on the control cells at the embedding's own precision, as Brieflow's ``tvn_on_controls`` does, which with ``whiten_epsilon`` 0 and a single-precision embedding reproduces Brieflow's TVN value for value.
records.label: spacr.ops_tvn.tvn_on_controls#7
records.source: how the control axes are found. ``'eigh'``, the default, takes them from a double-precision eigendecomposition of the control covariance (:func:`_control_basis`); ``'brieflow'`` fits scikit-learn's ``PCA`` on the control cells at the embedding's own precision, as Brieflow's ``tvn_on_controls`` does, which with ``whiten_epsilon`` 0 and a single-precision embedding reproduces Brieflow's TVN value for value.
records.translation: hur kontrollaxlarna hittas. ``'eigh'``, standardvärdet, tar dem från en egenvärdesuppdelning i dubbel precision av kontrollkovariansen (:func:`_control_basis`); ``'brieflow'`` anpassar ``PCA`` från scikit-learn på kontrollcellerna i inbäddningens egen precision, så som ``tvn_on_controls`` i Brieflow gör, vilket med ``whiten_epsilon`` 0 och en inbäddning i enkel precision återger TVN från Brieflow värde för värde.

records.context: ``(embedding, info)``. ``info`` lists the axes kept and the batches CORAL skipped because they had fewer control cells than axes or a singular covariance.
